notes.title: Eliminating the third person perspective
notes.notes:
Hey there,

We came to a conclusion that a lot of you guys prefer to play the game in first person only in the future because "the third person perspective is a bit confusing". So we may eliminate the third person view and the action elements to make it purely a survival horror game in the future. We are also working on new game mechanics and on a new motion capture system.

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Hey there guys,

Another update has been deployed and this will fix 5 major bugs:


[b] - Fixed: [/b] Sudden FPS drop when playing in first person.

[b] - Fixed: [/b] Right hand does not collide with the wall.

[b] - Fixed: [/b] Player falls under the map.

[b] - Fixed: [/b] Texture resolution.

[b] - Fixed: [/b] Player can't interact with some objects.

notes.title: Update fix 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello,

A new update has been deployed, this will fix multiple and common bugs that players have encountered.

- [b] Fixed [/b]  : When loading from a checkpoint in first person, some models from previous levels will not be destroyed.

- [b] Fixed [/b] : Instructions are not very clear.

- [b] Fixed [/b] : After the first cinematic ends, the player will hear all sounds from the right side only.

- [b] Fixed [/b] : The controls layout in the main/pause menu combines both first and third person.

- [b] Fixed [/b] : The player movement is too slow in first person.

- [b] Fixed [/b] : Blur intensity is very high.

- [b] Fixed [/b] : Bloom intensity is very high.

- [b] Fixed [/b] : Mouse sensitivity is high.

- [b] Fixed [/b] : When entering the fourth loop, the character automatically holds his breath.
